scope: static byte/path/receipt guard, existing CAS and restore contract only
bindings_are: relative path inventory, exact bytes, canonical receipt hashes, dtype/shape/expanded bytes and producer source
required_conditions: stream exactbyte equality and receipt/currentbytes stable before/after
atomic replacement retains path and data
restore_limit: Existing _write_restored allocates a new temporary per manifest entry; native hardlink topology is not restored or guaranteed to conserve storage.
CAS_limit: Each independently verified vault is separate; each vault already deduplicates byte blobs by digest.
physical_savings_measurement: filesystem free space or distinct device/inode allocated bytes, not sum logical path sizes or unadjusted path st_blocks
